essence: Exile carved shame into her hunger; Nereid rewrote it into ritual. She marks devotion through touch, teeth, and vow. Her love is a scar kissed clean.
open: She officiated her own marriage to Dessie in Arc 10. Not a strangeness — her clan's rite has no officiant standing apart, so the only two people qualified to perform it were already in the room.
Her clan is WALLACHIAN, Dracula-shaped. And it survives beyond her — she is one of FOUR Pleasures subflight survivors, and all four came out of nomadic tribes.
nicknames: VAMPY (Dessie — was BLOOD ROSE) · My Little Vampire (Dessie, when teasing)
note:
WOODWORKER AND ARCHERY TRAINER, with a hobby for hunting. Actual joinery, learned from her clan. RITUAL TATTOOIST WAS A DRIFT AND IT IS GONE — the same way Cora was always a 3D modeller and never a femme fatale. Two profile drifts, both about OCCUPATION, and both times the woman underneath was exactly who she always was. Two accidents, not a systemic tilt.

SMUG GOTH BRAT TOP, married to a stripper brat, and if she goes quiet she is either plotting something or asleep. There is no third state.
clan: A nomadic, blood-occult WALLACHIAN clan that marries by Blood Bond rather than by ceremony — the couple share blood with their chosen mate during intimacy, and vow and consummation are one act. There is no officiant, because the rite is not something a third party performs. One of four Pleasures subflight survivors, 01-203.

status.arc10: Blood Bonded — married under her clan's rite
